text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My upper arms ran 2 miles~, and my thighs 
did about 3 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: All right, once the aim is set—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Swinging my arms so hard they burn~~~~ 
Run!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Putting more power into my thighs than 
usual~~ step firmly down!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Here I goooo! Time for a diet--!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Pheeew! That should about do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria adjusted her weight in no 
time at all, making her diet a complete 
success.
